description: Source code for shopping cart functionality in ERPNext, including cart management, address handling, order placement, and shipping rules.

classes.name: WebsitePriceListMissingError
classes.description: Custom validation error for missing website price list

methods.name: set_cart_count
methods.description: Sets the cart item count in cookies if shopping cart is enabled

methods.name: get_cart_quotation
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a shopping cart quotation, including addresses and shipping rules

methods.name: get_shipping_addresses
methods.description: Returns shipping addresses for a given party

methods.name: get_billing_addresses
methods.description: Returns billing addresses for a given party

methods.name: place_order
methods.description: Converts cart quotation into a sales order, checking stock and submitting order

methods.name: request_for_quotation
methods.description: Submits the cart quotation as a RFQ

methods.name: update_cart
methods.description: Adds, updates, or removes items in the cart and updates the cart display

methods.name: get_shopping_cart_menu
methods.description: Renders the shopping cart dropdown menu

methods.name: add_new_address
methods.description: Creates a new address record

methods.name: create_lead_for_item_inquiry
methods.description: Creates a lead from an item inquiry with comments

methods.name: get_terms_and_conditions
methods.description: Fetches terms and conditions text by name

methods.name: update_cart_address
methods.description: Updates the cart with a new shipping or billing address

methods.name: apply_shipping_rule
methods.description: Applies a shipping rule to the cart quotation

methods.name: get_applicable_shipping_rules
methods.description: Returns applicable shipping rules based on address

methods.name: get_shipping_rules
methods.description: Fetches shipping rules based on address country

methods.name: get_address_territory
methods.description: Matches address city, state, country to existing territory

methods.name: show_terms
methods.description: Returns the terms and conditions name

methods.name: apply_coupon_code
methods.description: Validates and applies a coupon code to the cart

methods.name: _get_cart_quotation
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve or create a shopping cart quotation

methods.name: update_party
methods.description: Updates or creates a customer and related contact, then refreshes cart

methods.name: apply_cart_settings
methods.description: Applies cart settings like price list, taxes, and shipping rules

methods.name: set_price_list_and_rate
methods.description: Sets price list and resets item rates in quotation

methods.name: _set_price_list
methods.description: Determines and sets the appropriate price list for the quotation

methods.name: set_taxes
methods.description: Calculates and sets taxes based on billing address and settings

methods.name: get_party
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a party (customer/contact) for the user

methods.name: get_debtors_account
methods.description: Fetches or creates a debtors account for the shopping cart

methods.name: get_address_docs
methods.description: Retrieves address documents linked to a party

methods.name: _apply_shipping_rule
methods.description: Internal method to apply shipping rule and recalculate totals

methods.name: decorate_quotation_doc
methods.description: Enhances quotation items with additional item details

methods.name: guess_territory
methods.description: Guesses territory based on session country or default setting
